findings.excerpt: Assume AC. For every q≥1 and every CW model K_q=K(Z/2,q), H_n(K_q;Z) is finitely generated for every n; for n>0 it is a finite 2-primary group.
findings.symptom: The mathematical statement appears as plain text: expressions such as K_q=K(Z/2,q) and H_n(K_q;Z) are not typeset, leaving subscripts and formula syntax visible.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the mathematical expressions in inline or display math delimiters so the statement renders with mathematical notation.

findings.excerpt: 1.1 Proof of the base case. Take K_1=BO(1)=RP∞. Its orientation double cover is BSO(1)=V_1(R∞), contractible by the published stable-Stiefel theorem.
findings.symptom: The proof’s mathematical notation is plain text, including K_1, RP∞, BSO(1), π₁, and F-cohomology expressions, rather than rendered formulas.
findings.suggested_repair: Add math delimiters around formula expressions throughout the proof while preserving the prose.

findings.excerpt: Assume AC. Let f:W→X be a based map of 2-connected CW complexes and let D≥2. If π_i(f)⊗Q is an isomorphism for 2≤i≤D and a surjection for i=D+1, then H_i(f;Q) is an isomorphism for 0≤i≤D.
findings.symptom: The entire statement’s formulas are displayed as ordinary text, including f:W→X, π_i(f)⊗Q, and H_i(f;Q).
findings.suggested_repair: Use inline math delimiters for the mathematical expressions in the statement.

findings.excerpt: 1.1 Let F→E_f→X be the actual mapping-path fibration. The fiber exact sequence gives F path-connected and simply connected, because π_1(W)=π_1(X)=π_2(X)=0.
findings.symptom: Proof formulas are shown as plain text, including the mapping-path fibration and homotopy groups, so indices and mathematical structure are not typeset.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the formula expressions in math delimiters throughout the proof.

findings.excerpt: Assume AC. For every discrete group G, J(G) and B_wG are CW complexes; J(G) is path-connected and weakly contractible, and J(G)→B_wG is a covering with fiber G.
findings.symptom: The weak-join notation is rendered as ordinary text, e.g. B_wG, J(G), and K(G,1), exposing the underscore and untypeset formulas.
findings.suggested_repair: Typeset the model names and other mathematical notation using inline math delimiters.
